translations.web: He shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over. They shall pour out the mortar that they scraped off outside of the city into an unclean place.
translations.bsb: And he shall have the inside of the house scraped completely and the plaster that is scraped off dumped into an unclean place outside the city.
translations.kjv: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
translations.asv: and he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the mortar, that they scrape off, without the city into an unclean place:
